project.name: Memos
project.description: Open-source, self-hosted note-taking app built for quick capture. Markdown-native, single Go binary, data stays under the user's control.

components.name: Web Application
components.purpose: Everything the user sees and clicks: writing memos, browsing the timeline, settings.

components.name: Memo Editor
components.purpose: The writing surface: Markdown editing with autocomplete, syntax highlighting, and attachments.

components.name: Timeline & Browsing
components.purpose: Reading side: home timeline, memo detail, explore feed, archive, search and filters.

components.name: Settings & Admin UI
components.purpose: Account, workspace, and admin screens: users, identity providers, webhooks, access tokens.

components.name: API Layer
components.purpose: The front door for all clients: defines every operation (memos, users, auth, attachments) as typed services that both the web app and third-party tools call.

components.name: API Contracts
components.purpose: Protobuf definitions of every service and message; generated code keeps Go server and TypeScript client in sync.

components.name: Authentication & Identity
components.purpose: Controls who can log in and what they may do: sessions, access tokens, SSO via external identity providers, per-request authorization.

components.name: Memo System
components.purpose: The heart of the product: creating, editing, relating, sharing, commenting on and reacting to memos.

components.name: Markdown Engine
components.purpose: Parses memo text to extract structure: tags, links, mentions, tasks.

components.name: Attachments & File Storage
components.purpose: Handles uploaded images and files: storing them locally or in S3, serving them back, image/EXIF processing.

components.name: AI Features
components.purpose: Optional AI capabilities: speech-to-text for audio memos and LLM-backed helpers.

components.name: Integrations & Publishing
components.purpose: Ways the outside world connects: MCP server for AI agents, RSS feeds, outgoing webhooks, email notifications.

components.name: Data Storage
components.purpose: Single store layer that persists everything (memos, users, settings) and speaks three databases interchangeably.

components.name: Database Drivers
components.purpose: One implementation per supported database behind a common driver interface.

components.name: Schema Migrations
components.purpose: Versioned SQL that upgrades the database schema across releases, per driver.

components.name: Server Runtime
components.purpose: Boots and runs everything as one binary: startup, config profile, HTTP server wiring, background job scheduler, serving the built web app.

because: server/router/api/v1/authz.go and connect_interceptors.go enforce auth on every request
server/auth uses store user, user_identity, auth_config tables
memo payload built from parsed markdown (server/runner/memopayload)
memo_service_webhooks.go dispatches internal/webhook on memo events
password reset / notifications sent via internal/email (server/notification)
RSS and MCP routers render/serve memos
server/server.go mounts apiv1, fileserver, frontend, mcp, rss routers
cmd/memos/main.go opens store driver and runs migrator on boot
